info.title: Deskohub Workspace customer API
info.description: Authenticated by the Better Auth session cookie that /api/auth sets. Every request carries the x-deskohub-client: workspace-customer-api header; a request without it, or from another site, gets 403.

200.description: The issued invoice as a PDF document.

Content-Disposition.description: Serves the PDF as an attachment named by the invoice number, as `attachment; filename="<invoice number>.pdf"`.

CustomerCheckoutUnavailableReason.description: expired: the hold or its token ended, start a new checkout. payment_in_progress: a payment for the order has started. price_review_pending: accept the changed price first. not_payable: the order's payment is in progress or it can no longer be paid, open its status screen. reservation_ended: the booked time has passed. offer_replaced: the cowork offer booked is no longer sold.
